action.sql: SELECT g.dept_id FROM (SELECT dept_id, SUM(debit - credit) AS actual FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND period = '2026-04' AND account_id BETWEEN '6000' AND '6999' GROUP BY dept_id) g JOIN (SELECT dept_id, SUM(amount) AS budget FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND period = '2026-04' AND account_id BETWEEN '6000' AND '6999' GROUP BY dept_id) b ON g.dept_id = b.dept_id WHERE g.actual > b.budget
